title: Stock Market Close: Sensex extends winning run to third day, up 208 pts; Nifty ends at 25,935
text:
Stock Market Close Highlights | February 10, 2026:

Indian equity benchmarks ended higher for the third straight session on Tuesday, supported by positive cues from Asian markets and strong Q3 performance by select companies.

At the close, the BSE Sensex stood at 84,273.92, up 208.17 points or 0.25 per cent, while the NSE Nifty50 ended at 25,935.15, gaining 67.85 points or 0.26 per cent. In the last three trading sessions, Sensex has gained 959 points.

On the Sensex, Eternal, Tata Steel, Mahindra & Mahindra (M&M), and Tech Mahindra (Tech M) were among the top gainers. In contrast, HCL Technologies (HCLTech), Bajaj Finance, Adani Ports, and Bharti Airtel featured among the key laggards.

Sectorally, Nifty Media and Nifty Auto led gains, rising 2.4 per cent and 1.37 per cent, respectively, while Nifty PSU Pharma declined the most.

In the broader market, the Nifty MidCap and Nifty SmallCap indices closed 0.49 per cent and 0.38 per cent higher, respectively.
